children: Overview
Canadian cannabis cultivator's Q1 revenue rose 38% yr/yr to C$2.23 mln
Company posted positive adjusted EBITDA and cash from operations, but reported a net loss
Revenue growth was driven by record sales volume, while lower average selling prices weighed on margins
Outlook
Company expects refined product mix to better align with markets offering long-term value
Greenway aims to expand into new jurisdictions and develop strategic partnerships
Result Drivers
RECORD SALES VOLUME - Co said revenue growth was driven by record 2.33 mln grams sold, 8% above its previous quarterly high
LOWER SELLING PRICE - Co said lower average net selling price reflected sales of legacy inventory from discontinued cultivars, affecting gross margin
COST IMPROVEMENT - Co said cash cost per gram sold improved by 30% to C$0.69, reflecting disciplined execution in cultivation, processing and fulfillment
